snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Reclamation Update Available Now!
snippet.description:
Climb aboard and cleanse the void ship Wrath of Espandor with the Reclamation Update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, including new Blood Angels and Salamanders cosmetics, and more! It's available right now on PC, Playstation, and XBox. Find out more here: https://ow.ly/lXKs50Xxoii
